purpose: Compose existing prefix and immutable-scale certificates with actual loader and caller dataflow, and audit mission obligations 3 and 5 against unchanged criteria.
data: Small synthetic deterministic fixtures only; no historical or protected data reads.
implementation: No trading, research-algorithm, registration, model identifier or production behavior changes. Source-derived finite dataflow certificate plus SMT index/key lemmas and runtime conformance.
proofObligations: Every scale fit in the delivered runner consumes only admitted training prefixes.
Every admitted scale use is a read or a checked passthrough; snapshots have immutable bytes backing.
Each local price/funding pair is selected using the same symbol from loader through collector, replay and OPE.
Pooled training transforms and learned policies are explicitly shared inputs, not undeclared local market observations.
closureRule: Close an obligation only after exact source composition, mutation tests, formal reproduction and repository verification pass. Preserve unproved publication timing, full split isolation, numeric, lifecycle and empirical obligations.
assumptions: Ordinary pinned Python/NumPy/pandas primitives and SHA-256 collision resistance; no hostile subclasses, runtime patching, concurrent mutation or external arbitrary callbacks.
Source grammar, AST parser and proof checker are in the trusted computing base; compiler/library semantics are not re-proved.
counterexamples: Preserve deliberate foreign-symbol, full-panel fit and mutable-scale mutants as regression cases, separately from historical defects.
acceptance: No new candidate eligibility, adoption, holdout permission, deployment or live authority.
